<text:style bold="true">SVG Snippets</text:style>

<image:base64 col="0" width="33" wrap="none"></image:base64>

The snippets are small parametric drawings. To place one, press its button and click
two opposite corners of the box that it must fill. It becomes a group of ordinary
objects; its parameters (numbers, colours, tables of data) appear in the Properties
panel and can be changed later: the group is made again and the size and the
position are kept. The snippets are written in a small language of their own and are
kept in a library that can be extended (Edit > SVG Library...; the language is
explained in the topic SVG Snippets Language, also reached from the Help menu, SVG
Snippets). The buttons of this panel are always active.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Speech bubble</text:style>
A speech bubble, to put a text in.


<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Arrow</text:style>
A straight arrow: thickness, size of the head and colour can be set.


<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Arrow right</text:style>
A block arrow pointing right.


<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Pie graph</text:style>
A pie chart from a table of data: one row for each slice (label and value).
It can have a hole, the percentages and a legend.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Line graph</text:style>
A line chart from a table of data: the first column holds the labels and each
other column makes a line. Grid and dots are optional.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Scatter XY</text:style>
A scatter plot from a table of x;y values; more columns make more series.

<text:style bold="true">Table</text:style>
A table with rows of two alternating colours, from CSV data (one row per line, cells
separated by ; or , or a tab). If the first row is text it is the header, drawn in bold
white on its own colour. Numbers are aligned to the right. Parameters: the colours of
the odd rows, of the even rows, of the header and of the text (each with a colour
button), lines between the rows (1 = yes), the height of the rows and the size of the
text. The columns are as wide as their longest text. As for the other snippets you drag a box
first, then paste the data; the table is scaled to fit in the box keeping its proportions
(so the text is never distorted), and it follows the data when you change them.


<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Ruler</text:style>
A ruler: scale, number of ticks and colour can be set.


<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Squared paper</text:style>
A sheet of squared paper: number and size of the squares, line thickness and
colours.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Isometric grid</text:style>
A grid for isometric drawing: number and size of the cells, line thickness
and colours.
